results.content:
## Bottom Line & Recommendation

DiffSense is an essential utility for any developer using an Apple Silicon Mac who values speed, privacy, and control over their code intelligence workflows. If you are tired of uploading sensitive diffs to the cloud for basic commit summaries, DiffSense offers a high-performance, secure alternative that genuinely feels instantaneous. It’s a fantastic example of leveraging local hardware power to solve a common developer friction point. Highly recommended for Mac-based engineers seeking best-in-class, private AI tooling.

## Featured AI Applications

Discover powerful tools to enhance your productivity

## MindMax

New Way to Interact with AI [...] The primary problem DiffSense tackles is the trade-off between convenience and security often associated with cloud-based AI coding assistants. Traditional solutions require sending sensitive code diffs over the internet to external servers for processing, which introduces latency and, more critically, potential data exposure risks. For enterprises handling sensitive IP or individual developers deeply concerned about privacy, this is a significant hurdle. [...] True Local Execution: Zero reliance on external servers ensures maximum data privacy—a non-negotiable feature for many professional developers.
 Customizable Message Styles: Recognizing that a single commit style doesn't fit all projects, DiffSense allows users to tailor the output (e.g., conventional commits, subject-body formatting) to match their repository standards.
 Powerful Alias Macros: This feature significantly boosts workflow efficiency, allowing developers to quickly invoke complex formatting or boilerplate text within their generated commits, streamlining the entire process from `git diff` to `git commit`.

results.content:
## Repository files navigation

Logo

### DiffSense

AI-powered git commit messages running locally on your Mac with Apple Intelligence.   
   
 latest release total downloads

## Why DiffSense

 Private: Your code never leaves your machine - runs entirely on Apple Silicon
 Fast: Generates messages in seconds using AFM 3B model
 Smart: Handles changes from single files to 100+ file refactors
 Free: No subscriptions, API quotas, or cloud dependencies

## Requirements

 macOS Tahoe 26 or later
 git 2.50.1 or later
 Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4/M5)

### Install

1. In terminal: `curl -fsSL  | bash`
2. Download the Diffsense.shortcut
3. Stage your cahnges and call `diffsense` in your terminal

Example git commit message: [...] Example git commit message:

```
Add error handling in login flow Handle missing token case to prevent crash when API response is null. 
```

### Customization

Getting help:

 `diffsense --help` - Show all available options and usage information

Message style:

 `diffsense` - Balanced (default)
 `diffsense --verbose` - Detailed explanations
 `diffsense --minimal` - Brief descriptions
 `diffsense --verbose --nopopup` - Does not show message pop up.(Useful for agents)
 `diffsense --byo=team_rules.md` - Custom prompt instruction

AI models:

 `--afm` - On-device AFM 3B (default, private)
 `--pcc` - Private Cloud Compute (more capable)
 `--gpt` - ChatGPT 4o (best quality, quota limits)

Custom prompt instructions: [...] Custom prompt instructions:

 `--byo=` - Use custom commit message rules from a file
  + Examples:   
     `diffsense --byo=samplerules.md`  
     `diffsense --byo=samplerules.md --minimal`  
     `diffsense --byo=samplerules.md --verbose`  
     `diffsense --byo=samplerules.md --minimal --gpt`  
     `diffsense --byo=samplerules.md --verbose --nopopup`
  + See cstm\_cmt\_msg\_rules.md for an example template
 Supports absolute and relative paths for file paths.

 `--nopopup` - Skip edit dialog (useful for agents)

Terminal macros

 Add + diffsense + Push: `upload` install: `echo "alias upload='git add . && diffsense && git push'" >> ~/.zshrc`
 Add + diffsense: `commit` install: `echo "alias commit='git add . && diffsense'" >> ~/.zshrc`
